# Onward Dev Build v2.1.0-dev.20261112.1

Automated end-to-end verification baseline build (`dev` channel) for Windows seamless background auto-update.

## New Features
- Introduce background `.zip` archive extraction into `<installDir>\_` via `original-fs` worker thread on Windows.
- Bundle native Win32 GUI helper `onward-updater.exe` (`IMAGE_SUBSYSTEM_WINDOWS_GUI`) for silent atomic directory swap with automatic rollback.
- Support both immediate Restart-to-Update and silent swap on normal graceful window close.
